responsibility: This target header supplies COFF object-format conventions for AArch64, primarily for PE/COFF-based environments rather than ELF. It overrides low-level assembler and type-layout macros such as local-label syntax, `size_t`/`ptrdiff_t` spellings, `long` size, common/local symbol emission, alignment and skip directives, section names, and unsupported ELF-style function-size/type directives, so the AArch64 backend emits assembly and data-model defaults that match COFF toolchains.
